claims.title: Last surviving capture and current-token criterion
claims.statement: For every execution of the declared capture/invalidation/immutable-commit model, each snapshot cell contains the token from its last accepted capture surviving invalidation as of that snapshot's commit boundary, or absence. With the designated eager consumer actually reading that snapshot, it reads both intended tokens exactly when those two cells contain those actual tokens. Gate closure by itself neither clears nor revokes a retained token.

All premises must hold jointly for that instance and its stated episode family; no premise may be borrowed from an unrelated system or trial.

claims.title: Exact robust aperture and asynchronous same-episode join

Two safe windows admit a common sample iff their intersection is nonempty. Separate captures can be paired when each is nonempty and the same-episode, retention, atomicity, resource and deadline premises hold.
